summary: This bill amends the Energy Policy Act of 2005 to require the Department of Energy to submit public quarterly reports to specified House and Senate committees detailing its use of authority to reduce or waive cost-sharing requirements for energy research projects.

scores.thoughts: The bill adds quarterly reporting requirements on DOE's use of authority to waive cost-sharing for energy projects under the Energy Policy Act. This increases transparency around instances where federal spending may increase due to waived recipient contributions, but the bill itself neither authorizes new spending nor mandates reductions—it is strictly a procedural accountability measure. Thus, it has no directional impact on spending levels.
